data.narrative:
GrayMatter Robotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $70M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable set of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ), including same-stage competitors Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the company's last known post-money valuation of $300M, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $570M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $1.75B, with a range spanning $1.6B to $2.0B. These methodologies reflect materially different assumptions about GrayMatter's relative standing within its cohort.

The triangulated analysis produces a valuation range of $484M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $1.2B. The wide dispersion reflects genuine uncertainty about whether stage-progression or peer benchmarking better reflects market conditions for Series B robotics companies. Reconciling these methods requires clarity on: (1) whether GrayMatter's last funding round is recent enough to anchor forward valuation, and (2) whether the selected peers represent appropriate comparability on technology maturity, revenue traction, and capital efficiency. Resolution of these factors is essential before drawing a point estimate.
